narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Three gaps and two signs. Three times two makes six ways, so we are nearly done.
<bookmark mark='tree'/>Draw the choices as a tree, where the first gap gives two branches.
<bookmark mark='double'/>Each new gap splits every branch in two again: two, then four, then eight.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>There are eight ways, not six, and four are still to write.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 3 gaps × 2 signs = 6 ways; a tree of sign choices grows from 2 branches to 4 to 8; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Count the ways first, two for each gap, then list them in order.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Put signs between one, two, three and four, with one in front. Are all eight answers even?
